instruction: Set up auto-save in VS Code to trigger whenever you switch focus away from the editor.

metadata.explanation: Task requires modifying VS Code settings to enable auto-save on focus change. Similar pattern to original task but targets files.autoSave setting. Evaluator checks if files.autoSave is set to 'onFocusChange' in settings.json.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks if files.autoSave is set to 'onFocusChange' in VS Code settings.json
Getter logic is correct: downloads /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json from VM to a temporary file
Metric logic is correct: parses JSON file and verifies the specific setting using exact match comparison
Expected value 'onFocusChange' is semantically correct for VS Code's auto-save on focus change feature
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (enable auto-save on focus change) and evaluator checks exactly this
Practical feasibility: VS Code settings.json is persisted to disk immediately, no postconfig needed
Edge cases handled: getter returns empty string if file not found, metric returns 0.0 if file can't be parsed
